items.headline: High Surf Advisory issued November 16 at 2:11PM PST until November 17 at 4:00AM PST by NWS San Francisco CA
items.description:
* WHAT...Large breaking waves of 20 to 25 ft, with occasional
sets of 25 to 35 ft at favored breakpoints.

* WHERE...San Francisco, Coastal North Bay Including Point Reyes
National Seashore, San Francisco Peninsula Coast, Northern
Monterey Bay and Southern Monterey Bay and Big Sur Coast
Counties.

* WHEN...Until 4 AM PST Tuesday.

* IMPACTS...Large breaking waves can overpower swimmers, pulling
people into the sea from beaches, jetties, and rocks resulting
in significant physical injury and increasing the risk of
drowning.
items.instruction:
Swimmers should remain out of the water due to dangerous surf
conditions.

items.headline: Wind Advisory issued November 16 at 1:40PM PST until November 18 at 1:00PM PST by NWS San Francisco CA
items.description:
* WHAT...Southwest winds 20 to 30 mph with gusts up to 50 mph
expected.

* WHERE...The Pacific Coast.

* WHEN...From 9 PM Tuesday to 1 PM PST Wednesday.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down and a few power outages may result.
items.instruction:
Winds this strong can make driving difficult, especially for high
profile vehicles. Use extra caution.
